Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
Let the Lord be praised. I will give praise to the Lord with all my heart, among the upright, and in the meeting of the people.
你們要讚美耶和華！我要在正直人的大會中，並公會中，一心稱謝耶和華。
Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
The works of the Lord are great, searched out by all those who have delight in them.
耶和華的作為本為大；凡喜愛的都必考察。
Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
His work is full of honour and glory; and his righteousness is unchanging for ever.
他所行的是尊榮和威嚴；他的公義存到永遠。
He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
Certain for ever is the memory of his wonders: the Lord is full of pity and mercy.
他行了奇事，使人記念；耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫。
He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
He has given food to his worshippers; he will keep his agreement in mind for ever.
他賜糧食給敬畏他的人；他必永遠記念他的約。
He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
He has made clear to his people the power of his works, giving them the heritage of the nations.
他向百姓顯出大能的作為，把外邦的地賜給他們為業。
The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
The works of his hands are faith and righteousness; all his laws are unchanging.
他手所行的是誠實公平；他的訓詞都是確實的，
They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
They are fixed for ever and ever, they are done in faith and righteousness.
是永永遠遠堅定的，是按誠實正直設立的。
He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
He has sent salvation to his people; he has given his word for ever: holy is his name and greatly to be feared.
他向百姓施行救贖，命定他的約，直到永遠；他的名聖而可畏。
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
The fear of the Lord is the best part of wisdom: all those who keep his laws are wise: his praise is eternal.
敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端；凡遵行他命令的是聰明人。耶和華是永遠當讚美的！
